title: WIN A BRAND NEW 2026 LAND ROVER DEFENDER 110 OR £50,000 TAX-FREE CASH!
body:
Choose Your Dream Car Or £50,000 Tax-Free Cash - Terms and Conditions  
These specific competition terms and conditions should be read together with, and are in addition to, Bauer Media Group: Competition General Terms & Conditions at: https://www.bauerlegal.co.uk/competition-general-terms-and-conditions (the “General Terms”).   
Together these specific competition terms and conditions and the General Terms shall be referred to as the “Terms”. Where there is a conflict between these specific competition terms and conditions and the General Terms, these specific competition terms and conditions shall prevail.   

ITEM 1: COMPETITION NAME   
“Choose Your Dream Car Or £50,000 Tax-Free Cash” running from the Start Date to the End Date as set out below (the “Competition”).   

ITEM 2: PROMOTER   
Bauer Radio Limited, registered office: Media House Peterborough Business Park, Lynch Wood, Peterborough, United Kingdom, PE2 6EA and registered under company number 01394141 (the “Promoter”).   
This is a Rayo Network Competition, running on the Websites. The Competition will be promoted on the Websites and on other channels including but not limited to radio stations, SMS, social media, apps, email newsletters and magazines.   

ITEM 3: WEBSITES   
The websites shall be www.makemeawinner.co.uk and hellorayo.co.uk (the “Websites”).  

ITEM 4: COMPETITION START DATE, END DATE AND ENTRY PERIODS   
Entry to the Competition will open and close as follows:    
Online, SMS and Postal Start Date: Sunday 16 August 2026 at 20:30pm
Online and SMS End Date: Wednesday 14 October 2026 at 20:00pm;  
Postal Entries Must Be Received By: Tuesday 20 October 2026 at 5:00pm.   
Any entries received outside the relevant entry route dates (as stated above) will be invalid, but you may still be charged.   
We reserve the right to broadcast the Competition at any time throughout each day during the broadcast schedule.   
Please note that the Competition entry periods as specified in these specific competition terms and conditions are final and are not impacted by the time of broadcast of announcements advertising how to enter the Competition, which may in some circumstances be delayed.   
   
ITEM 5: COMPETITION DETAILS   
After the Start Date, the prize (the “Prize”) will be announced on the Websites. The Prize will be what the entrants are trying to win.   
We reserve the right to announce the Prize at any time during the Competition. We may also advertise the Prize on-air, on social media or via an SMS marketing message or via any other medium at our absolute discretion.   
As part of the Competition, we may advertise multiple possible cars entrants could win but there is only one Prize available and all entries for the Competition will be pooled together into a single draw.    
After the Competition has closed, one entrant from all the valid entries will be selected by automated random draw.  
The entrant who is randomly selected will win the Prize on offer. The entrant selected will be contacted by the Make Me A Winner team to co-ordinate prize fulfilment.   
The entrant selected may be required to talk to a presenter / the programming team, and the call may be recorded and played on-air (assuming there is no breach of the Terms).   
   
ITEM 6: ROUTES OF ENTRY, ENTRY LIMITS AND COSTS   
Entrants are responsible for all costs associated with entering this Competition and entrants must have permission from the bill payer before entering. Bauer is not responsible for any network or technical issues an entrant may experience, which may delay or prevent their participation.   

SMS   
SMS entries must be received between the SMS Start Date and the SMS End Date.   
Entrants can send up to 6 SMS messages in total starting with the keyword CAR to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 81215 or 65115. Entrants will receive 25 entries per message. A single SMS entry costs £5.00 (from the UK) + 1 standard network rate message. Entrants will receive an automated SMS response from 82205 to confirm their entry. 
 
Entrants can send 1 SMS message in total starting with the keyword TURBO to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 81215, 65115 or 82210. Entrants will receive 100 entries into the Competition for the cost of 1 SMS message. SMS messages starting with TURBO cost £10.00 (from the UK) + 1 standard network rate message. Entrants will receive an automated SMS response from 82210 to confirm their entry.  
 
If the SMS message does not start with a valid keyword, or is not sent to a valid number, it will not be entered. SMS entries to the Competition may be charged outside of any inclusive message bundles. The delivery of this message may be delayed at peak times.    
We reserve the right to run bonus SMS entry incentives throughout the duration of the Competition. These incentives will be communicated via SMS message. Where we operate an incentive, the entry limits may change.   

ONLINE   
Online entries must be received between the Online Start Date and the Online and End Date.  
Entrants can enter each sub-competition a maximum of 400 times (including entry bundles) in total. This equates to a maximum of 1,200 entries to the Competition across the Websites in total.  
A single online entry costs £1.00. The use of a debit or credit card may incur charges from your provider. There is a minimum basket spend of £2 on each of the Websites.   
We reserve the right to run entry incentives online throughout the duration of the Competition. These incentives will be communicated via email and/or the Websites. Where we operate an incentive, the online entry limit may change.   
  
POST   
Postal entries must be received between the Postal Start Date and Tuesday 20 October 2026 at 5:00pm.   

Entrants can enter the Competition by sending their name and mobile telephone number to MMAW BR8915 (for the Land Rover Defender), MMAW BR9015 (for the Mercedes AMG A45 S), MMAW BR9115 (for the BMW M340i), PO Box 8162, Derby, DE1 9GU. Entries must be sent on a postcard or on or within an envelope. Entries received on anything other than a postcard or envelope will not be valid or accepted. In the case of multiple entries received in a single envelope or on a single postcard, only one entry will be entered into the Competition. Entries that include a landline telephone number instead of a mobile number will be invalid and not accepted. 

There is no cap on the number of postal entries.     
    
ITEM 7: ENTRANT RESTRICTIONS   
The Competition is only open to people aged 18 and over who: (i) live in the United Kingdom (excluding Channel Islands and Isle of Man), (ii) are not a Bauer employee or their immediate family (including live-in partner) and (iii) are not an employee of any third-party sponsors or prize providers, or their immediate family (including live-in partner).   
Entrants must have a valid UK mobile number, UK bank account in their own name, valid email address and UK postal address in their own name.   
All entrants must enter on their own behalf and may not enter on behalf of anyone else.  If we later become aware that the person who played the Competition was not the entrant themselves, we will disqualify this entrant and no prize will be payable to any persons involved.   
   
ITEM 8: WINNER ANNOUNCEMENT   
Entrants who are randomly selected will be contacted by the phone number provided with their entry. We may contact entrants as part of a radio broadcast live on air or off-air. Due to programming schedules, this may not be broadcast on all participating radio stations.   
The name, hometown, photo and any video or audio recording of the winner may also be posted on the Websites and/or social media platforms and associated Bauer publications.  
   
By entering the Competition, the entrant is automatically consenting to being contacted and having their name and location announced on-air, on the Websites and/or social media platforms and associated Bauer applications.   
 
Only one prize can be won throughout the duration of this Competition. Clause 4.12 ("Prize Limits") of the Bauer Media Group Competition General Terms & Conditions shall not apply to the Competition. To be explicit, if you win this competition, you will still be able to enter Make Me A Winner or other competitions on makemeawinner.co.uk moving forwards. 
   
ITEM 9: PRIZE DETAILS   

There will be one winner of the Competition and only one Prize is available. All entrants from each of the ‘sub-competitions’ will be pooled together and entered into one overall prize draw and the selected winner will be able to choose a prize from the following options:  
 
(a) a Land Rover Defender; (b) a Mercedes AMG A45 S; or (c) a BMW M340i 

We may offer a cash alternative at our discretion.  

The cash alternative for all cars in this competition will be £50,000.  
  
If the car, option is chosen, the Make Me A Winner team will source the chosen car, for the winner, after the Competition closes.   
The cars advertised in the Competition are indicative and do not reflect the exact car, or specification, the winner will win, but do reflect the model of the car they will win. The cars will be ‘nearly new’ or ‘brand new’. In this context, the cars will be 2026 (26) plate. 

  
If the cash alternative option is chosen, it will be delivered to a winner paid in cash, by bank transfer or by cheque within 28 days of the winner passing our compliance checks.   
Delivery or payment of the Prize is subject to the winner providing personal identification and/or proof of address and passing our internal compliance checks within 14 days of being contacted.  
   
If we are unable to contact a winner to award the Prize within 14 days of the draw date, or if the winner is unable to provide us with personal identification and/or proof of address within 14 days of being contacted, the winner forfeits entirely their right to the Prize, and we reserve the right to award this to an alternative winner where possible.   
The Prize is non-transferable and cannot be exchanged. Payment of any cash elements may take up to 28 days from the point at which the Promoter receives the correct details.  
   
The car elements of the Prize are subject to availability.   

The car elements of the Prize do not include insurance, MOT or tax or any customisations or upgrades.  
We will arrange for delivery of the car elements of the Prize. Bauer is not liable if you are unable to accept delivery at the agreed time. Any additional delivery and third party storage costs due to failure to accept the car element of the Prize at the agreed time are your responsibility.  

We will work with the winner in good faith to arrange delivery of the car element of the Prize promptly and in good faith but we cannot be held liable for delays outside our reasonable control.  

Where, it emerges after the Prize has been awarded that the entrant was in breach of the Terms, we reserve the right to withdraw the Prize from that winner and they will not be entitled to any further reward or remuneration. We reserve the right to exclude individuals who breach the Terms from entering our competitions.   

ITEM 10: DATA PROTECTION    
By entering the Competition by SMS, entrants are automatically consenting to receiving marketing communications from the Promoter via SMS text message. Entrants can opt out of this at any time by texting: STOP to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 81215, or 65115. This will be charged at 1 standard network rate message. Entrants’ personal data will (regardless of whether they opt-out) always be used to process their entry. For further information on this, please see the General Terms and our privacy policy at: http://www.bauerdatapromise.co.uk/.   

ITEM 11: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND CONSENT   
We will sometimes (at our discretion) telephone entrants and ask them to speak on-air. They have the right to refuse. If they consent, their voice will be recorded, and they consent to this recording being used on our radio broadcasts. Entrants agree that we will own this recording and that a copy of it will be stored for further exploitation, which may include promotion.   
Entrants will not be put through to speak on-air if we think they are driving illegally, intoxicated, likely to swear, or otherwise offend our listeners. Whilst on air for the purposes of this Competition entrants must not use foul language, swear, say or do anything defamatory or illegal or say or do anything which would damage the reputation of the Promoter, is offensive or inappropriate or which would cause us, or our listeners, harm. Failure to comply will result in disqualification, and if the entrant has won the Prize, this will be forfeited.   

ITEM 12: OTHER CONDITIONS   
We will only accept entries that comply with the Terms, and we may disqualify the entrant if we know or suspect that they have breached them. If the disqualification occurs after a winner has been announced, one further entrant from all the valid entries will be selected by automated random draw and awarded the Prize.   
All our decisions relating to the Competition and/or awarding of prizes are final. No discussions or correspondence with entrants or any other person will be entered into about the operation of this Competition. We have the right to cancel, amend, terminate, or suspend this Competition if forced to do so due to circumstances outside our control.   
We reserve the right to amend the Terms.   
By entering the Competition, you agree to be bound by the Terms.   

ITEM 13: CONTACT DETAILS   
If entrants are having trouble entering the Competition, please check the FAQs here: https://hellorayo.co.uk/competition-faqs/ or here: https://makemeawinner.co.uk/faqs.   
Alternatively, write to Make Me A Winner, Bauer Media, 75 Hampstead Road, London, NW1 2PL (please do not send entries to this address). We cannot consider any queries made more than 14 days after the date the winner is announced.
summary:
CHOOSE YOUR DREAM CAR – A BRAND NEW LAND ROVER DEFENDER 110 OR £50,000 TAX-FREE CASH!

Adventure awaits! Will you conquer every landscape in the legendary Land Rover Defender 110, or choose an instant reward of £50,000 tax-free cash instead?

The Land Rover Defender 110 redefines what it means to travel in bold style and rugged comfort. Equipped with a robust 3.0L diesel engine and smooth automatic gearbox, this iconic SUV delivers unstoppable power wherever the road - or trail - takes you. The Defender 110’s roomy 5-seat, 5-door layout ensures space for friends, family, and all the adventure gear you’ll ever need, while its versatile SUV body type is built for exploration without limits.

Specifications:

• Engine: 3.0L

• Fuel: Diesel

• Gearbox: Automatic

• Seats: 5

• Doors: 5

• Body type: SUV

Take the keys to outstanding capability and refined comfort, or put £50,000 tax-free straight into your pocket - the choice is yours.

How to Enter:
Simply choose the number of entries you want before the competition closes at 8:00pm on Wednesday 14 October.

Every entry is in with a fair chance! If you're our lucky winner, we’ll give you a call - and follow up with an email if you entered online. You’ll have 14 days to claim your prize.

Will you dare to explore in a new Land Rover Defender 110… or cash in on £50,000 tax-free?

Enter now and get ready for your next big adventure!
